verdict.rationale: The axis applies to a personal-assistant agent. The vendor claims it follows up on threads you've dropped, and testers report it nudging about forgotten items and acting on context right away, which implies it retains context over time. However, the evidence is about connected-data indexing and proactive follow-ups (emails stored for later searches), not an explicit memory of prior chat conversations applied in new ones. Missing for 10: documented cross-conversation chat memory feature, user controls to view/edit/delete remembered context, hands-on evidence of recall from earlier chats.
